name: CSS Arbiter
note: R13.6, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.33. The sheet draws the FULLY REFITTED ship at 185 points and prices each refit as a deduction, so the hull here is the Y160 original: eight phaser-1s and two plasma-G, 185 - 6 - 15 - 10 - 12 = 142. The four refits add or convert their way back up to the printed ship. The Y180 Sabot refit (+10) is deliberately absent: it allows speed-40 torpedoes under FP11.0 in Module R10, which is out of scope.

refits.name: PH-3 refit
refits.label: PH-3
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PH-3 REFIT, DELETE ALL PHASER-3s.

refits.name: PPD refit
refits.label: PPD
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PPD REFIT, DELETE THE PPD. E11.16 bars PPDs from hulls smaller than size class 3; this one is size 3 exactly.

refits.name: PL-S refit
refits.label: Plasma-S
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-S REFIT, PLASMA-S TORPEDOES 'B' AND 'C' ARE PLASMA-G TORPEDOES. A conversion, not an addition — and scoped to B and C by designator so it cannot reach the plasma-F the next refit adds, whatever order the two are ticked in.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE ALL PLASMA-F TORPEDOES. R13.1C's REAR-FIRING torpedoes, flagged iscRearFiring, which is the anchor for the whole clause. BUILT: no PPTs; only ONE may fire at a size-class-4-or-larger ship per turn (ground bases count as size 4+ whatever their size); fixed in direction three or five with no swivels, which needs no code because ArcUtils derives a single launch direction from L+LR and from R+RR. NEEDS NO CODE: 'cannot identify drones' disambiguates the phrase 'fire-control system' for a reader, and no plasma launcher identifies drones in the first place (owner, 2026-10-22). STILL OPEN: two of them may not fire at the same target on the same impulse.
